title: 3.0rc3/Combo - Incorrect IOB after Occlusion alarm during prime
symptom: After an occlusion alarm during priming, AAPS did not mark the interrupted bolus as prime but as a regular bolus, resulting in incorrect IOB above 2 in the middle of the night.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause, but it is implied that due to limitations of the Combo comms, an interrupted bolus during prime was not correctly recorded, leading to incorrect IOB.
fix: The maintainers suggest that in such edge cases, the user should manually check and correct the pump and AAPS state, as the user did by deleting the bolus in the Treatment list.
evidence_quote: Rule No.1 is when anything goes wrong always check pump and AAPS state and do manual correction (exactly what you did)
